tests.title: PW-001 Negative: Update quantity; invalid coupon remains independent; missing required address blocks checkout.
PW-002 Positive: Guest adds a configurable product to a multi-line cart, rejects an invalid coupon, then follows the verified local checkout path.
PW-003 Boundary: A guest removes the final configurable-product line from a one-line cart after the valid-coupon state has been exercised.
PW-004 Negative: Registered customer updates quantity beyond available stock; checkout stops before address, shipping, and payment.
PW-005 Boundary: Registered customer removes the final simple-product line and leaves an empty cart.
PW-006 Boundary: Registered customer adds a simple product at the exact stock limit, applies a valid coupon, and completes the local checkout path.
PW-007 Positive: Guest adds a configurable product within stock to a multi-line cart and completes checkout locally.
PW-008 Boundary: Guest removes the final configurable-product line from a one-line cart; the invalid-coupon state is independently checked.
PW-009 Boundary: Guest updates a configurable product to the exact available-stock limit and continues through local checkout.
PW-010 Negative: Guest attempts to add an out-of-stock configurable product and checkout does not start.
PW-011 Negative: Guest updates a simple product in a multi-line cart, exercises a valid coupon, then submits an address missing a required field.
PW-012 Boundary: Registered customer adds a configurable product at the exact stock limit, then submits an address missing a required field.
PW-013 Negative: Registered customer updates a configurable product beyond stock; invalid coupon remains an independent operation.
PW-014 Negative: Registered customer updates a simple product beyond available stock while the product is otherwise in stock.
